from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Citation information extracted from a single provided paper."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific document")
    references_to_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the *other provided papers* (from the collection) that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography or text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCitationInfo]
